description: Searches the Aloha Fungi product catalog (functional mushroom supplements) by phrase: name, Latin name, or common alias. Returns LIVE catalog data (price from, availability). Prices and availability come from the live catalog. When forma/linia are given, price and availability describe ONLY the matching variant, not the whole product.

forma.description: Variant form filter (optional): kapsulki, proszek or krople.

fraza.description: Search phrase, e.g. "reishi" or "sleep". Empty string returns full catalog.

linia.description: Product line filter (optional): longevity or prime.

rodzaj.description: Species filter, product handle (optional), e.g. "reishi" or "lions-mane".

sort.description: Result sort (optional): cena_asc, cena_desc or nazwa.

name: search_products
title: Search products
